checks.exercise: wide-grip-cable-row front and side eight-frame sheets inspected
checks.equipment: Cable pulleys, handles and moving weight stacks
checks.setup: 벤치에 앉아 발판에 발을 대고 양쪽 손잡이를 어깨보다 넓게 잡는다.
checks.hands: Closed hands stay aligned with handles throughout
checks.feet: Feet on footplates; pelvis on seat and trunk fixed
checks.movement: 몸통을 세운 채 팔꿈치를 옆으로 벌리며 손잡이를 몸 쪽으로 당기고 천천히 편다.

limitations: Procedural slow demonstration with simplified equipment, not human motion capture.
Single-arm row demonstrates left arm only; wide row uses two independent handles.
Seventeen geometry samples do not certify full mesh collision or biomechanics.
